toegepas.voor: in prente en dinge om jou kan raaksien
toegepas.na: in prente en in dinge om jou heen kan raaksien
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'om jou heen' is the natural Afrikaans for 'around you', and repeating 'in' keeps the two places parallel.
toegepas.fout: 'dinge om jou' is a clipped form of the fixed expression 'om jou heen'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'om jou heen' is the natural Afrikaans, and repeating 'in' keeps the two places parallel without changing what is said.

toegepas.blok: Die vorm van 'n dier en van sy dele
toegepas.rede_vinder: An existential sentence starting with a place reads more naturally with 'is daar'.
toegepas.fout: an existential sentence opening with a long place phrase lacks 'daar' and reads stiffly
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'is daar' is the natural Afrikaans construction here; the protected names are untouched and the meaning is the same.

toegepas.blok: Tekstuur: vel, vag, vere en skubbe
toegepas.voor: Die neus is nie glad nie en het knoppies en ribbels.
toegepas.na: Die neus is nie glad nie. Dit het knoppies en ribbels.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Joining a negative and a positive statement with 'en' is clumsy; two short sentences are clearer for Grade 4.
toegepas.fout: a negative and a positive statement joined by 'en', followed by a second 'en', makes the Grade 4 reader stumble
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two short sentences say exactly the same and read more easily, and 'Dit' can only point to the nose.

toegepas.voor: Hulle plek langs mekaar is wat hulle verwant maak.
toegepas.na: Dit is hulle plek langs mekaar wat hulle verwant maak.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The cleft construction 'Dit is ... wat' is the natural Afrikaans way to give this emphasis.
toegepas.fout: 'Hulle plek langs mekaar is wat hulle verwant maak' copies the English pseudo-cleft
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Dit is ... wat' is the natural Afrikaans way to give this emphasis and the claim is unchanged.

toegepas.blok: Hoe jy na 'n dier se prent kyk
toegepas.voor: langs mekaar op die wiel lê
toegepas.na: langs mekaar op die kleurwiel lê
toegepas.rede_vinder: In a separate block 'die wiel' is a vague reference; the full term is clearer.
toegepas.fout: 'die wiel' in a separate block is a loose reference to the term the lesson teaches
toegepas.rede_keurder: Using the full term 'kleurwiel' is clearer for a block read on its own and changes nothing else.

laat_vaar.blok: Hoe jy na 'n dier se prent kyk
laat_vaar.voor: Kyk net so na jou eie prent
laat_vaar.na: Kyk op dieselfde manier na jou eie prent
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Net so' can read as 'just like that'; 'op dieselfde manier' says clearly that the same steps are meant.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'net so' is natural Afrikaans for 'in the same way', and the proposal is a lateral move that also repeats 'dieselfde' with the next sentence.

na_skrywer.voor: rangskik die kleure in 'n ronde volgorde wat ons 'n kleurwiel noem
na_skrywer.na: plaas die kleure in volgorde in 'n kring. Ons noem so 'n kring 'n kleurwiel
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'n Ronde volgorde' is wooden; an order is not round, the arrangement is a circle.
na_skrywer.fout: 'n ronde volgorde' is wooden: an order is not round, the arrangement is
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but the proposal makes the colour wheel a circle rather than an arrangement, which moves this sentence away from the decided kleurwiel definition it paraphrases, so the writer should fix it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Tekstuur: vel, vag, vere en skubbe
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Voel glad' is the natural collocation for touch; 'bly glad' reads oddly (reviewer: drop if the 'stays smooth' nuance is wanted).
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'bly glad' carries the point that the picture stays smooth despite showing a bumpy nose; 'voel glad' loses that contrast and the original reads fine.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Hoe jy na 'n dier se prent kyk
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The other steps are linked by eers, dan and laastens; this one stands unlinked, and 'ook' keeps the sequence flowing.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: A list of plain imperatives already reads well without a linking word; adding 'ook' is a lateral move.
